text:
emma_sales: SignalBridge RFI arrived. Asks: private VPC deploy, customer-managed HSM (FIPS), PII must be redacted at source OR cryptographic proof that plaintext never left customer subnet. They want capability matrix + 2-week POC plan + ballpark pricing by Fri. Can SE/SRE scope?

rafael_se: Paste the RFI link and exact clause? Need to know if tokenization acceptable.

emma_sales: Link: https://signalbridge.example/rfi/2026.pdf. Clause: "No plaintext PHI may leave customer network unless customer HSM guarantees vendor never accesses cleartext."

zoe_sre: For BYO-HSM we support KMIP proxy or on-prem appliance. KMIP needs mutual-TLS and VPC peering. Estimate 24-72h after network info.

rafael_se: In matrix propose three options: 1) client SDK tokenization, 2) Private in-customer subnet with HSM proxy, 3) on-prem appliance. Add quick tradeoffs (latency, ops, compliance).

carol_pricing: Draft placeholders: POC (2w) $12k, Dedicated $6.5k/mo, Private setup $50k + $8k/mo, appliance +$85k. Draft only.

diego_legal: If they demand zero vendor key access, escalate to on-prem SOW and change liability. Also confirm acceptance of SOC2 + pen test.

attachments-bot: uploaded "signalbridge-rfi.pdf" and "capability-matrix-initial.csv" (internal).

rafael_se: POC deliverables for matrix: sample redaction flow, throughput smoke 80 rps (1KB), signed audit traces proving no plaintext egress, integration runbook + firewall snippet.

zoe_sre: Firewall snippet: allow tcp 443 from signalbridge-admin to redwood-private-proxy:443; allow control plane 10250-10255 from redwood-control.

emma_sales: Actions: Rafael - update matrix with options + POC bullets by Thu EOD. Zoe - provide provisioning ETA + HA notes. Carol - validate prices. Diego - review contract language. I'll set up security sync Fri 9am PT. :thumbsup:
